time_split.method: decode = sum tap timings.predicted_ms, prefill = sum timings.prompt_ms over every tap record (replies and summarisation calls); other = record wall_s minus both (tool time, pi overhead, the in-flight request killed at timeout, which the tap never logs).

reply_tokens.method: Replies paired with agent-kind tap records by position. predicted_n from the tap; thinking share = thinking chars / (thinking + text + tool-call JSON chars); estimated reasoning tokens = predicted_n * share.

thinking_resent.method: Consecutive agent requests with no compaction between. resid = prompt_tokens[i+1] - prompt_tokens[i] - (tool-result chars between them)/4. If thinking is resent, resid ~ predicted_n[i]; if not, resid ~ predicted_n[i] * (1 - thinking share). Discriminating pairs: share >= 0.3 and predicted_n >= 100.

prompt_composition_at_pressure.method: At each compaction_start and each context-overflow reply: thinking and tool-result chars/4 accumulated since the previous compaction_end (or session start), divided by the last known prompt_tokens. The rest (system prompt, summary, retained pre-compaction messages, user text, text and tool calls) is not split.

tool_results.method: tool_execution_end results from events.jsonl (already truncated by pi): chars of text content, lines = newlines + 1. Big = more than 16384 chars (16 KB) or more than 400 lines.

compactions.method: Summarisation calls are tap records after the first with n_messages <= 2; consecutive ones form a run paired with a compaction by position. Duration = last request end (ts + wall_s) minus first request ts; output tokens = sum predicted_n. A timeout counts if the kill falls inside a logged run or within 300 s after it, or if the last compaction event is a compaction_start (summary in flight; no tap record exists for it).

length_stops.method: Replies with stopReason=length. Loop = some 200-char window (stride 10) of the last 4000 chars of thinking+text occurs at least 3 times in those 4000 chars.
